claims.text: HIS CO-AUTHOR OF TWENTY-NINE YEARS REPUDIATED THE BOOK. Peter Robbins published a statement on 13 June 2017, updated 20 June 2017. His specific allegations: a fabricated photograph purporting to show Warren with John Lennon; an altered USAF Form 490 medical appointment card on which the notation 'OPTI/RET BURN/EXP' is attributed to a 'Dr. Echols' whom Robbins says was an orthopaedic surgeon and not an ophthalmologist; signature inconsistencies on an in-processing sheet where 'Lea' is signed twice in different pens against a typed 'Lee'; and testimonial letters attributed to fellow airmen Steve LaPlume and Steve Longero that Robbins says were never sent.

edges.label: Reported as stating that Warren 'was not there'
edges.note: TIER 3. This reaches the board through search-result summaries and a video title and NOT through any document written or signed by Halt. ianridpath.com, which carries the most-cited sceptical treatment, returned an SSL handshake failure on both http and https. A primary would move this to Tier 2.

edges.label: Claims presence at the December 1980 events; contested
edges.note: TIER 2 AND CONTESTED. His assignment to the 81st Tactical Fighter Wing is not what is disputed; his presence at the events and the documents he produced for it are. His co-author repudiated the account on 13 June 2017 and the publisher suspended distribution of the book on 17 October 2017.

edges.label: Co-author of twenty-nine years publishes a detailed repudiation, 13 June 2017
edges.note: TIER 1 FOR THE FACT OF THE REPUDIATION BY THE NAMED CO-AUTHOR AND FOR THE PUBLISHER'S RESPONSE TO IT. The specific allegations, an altered USAF Form 490 with an ophthalmic notation attributed to an orthopaedic surgeon, a fabricated Lennon photograph, mismatched signatures and unsent testimonial letters, are Robbins's findings and the underlying documents were not opened here. He concedes the authenticity of Warren's January 1981 letter home.

edges.label: Co-author of a book-length treatment of the event, later repudiated by him
edges.note: AUTHORSHIP RELATION, TYPED research. Left at East Gate, with Larry Warren, defended for twenty-nine years and then repudiated in June 2017.
